bear_eye2 = sphere( radius=0.4, pos=vec(-5.5, 3.5, 2), opacity=0.8, color=vec(0,0,0) )

# 곰이 새에게 접근하는 애니메이션
for step in range(5):

    bear.pos.x += 0.5  # 곰이 매 스텝마다 오른쪽으로 0.5 이동

rate(0.5)  # 1초에 10 프레임

from vpython import *

# 화면 설정
scene = canvas(title='곰과 새의 이야기')
text(text= 'story of bear and bird', pos=vector(-6,6,0), color=color.white)

# 새 객체 생성
bird_head = sphere(pos=vector(0, 1, 0), radius=0.5, color=vec(1/4,1/4,1) )
bird_wing1 = box(pos=vector(0.5, 1, 0), size=vector(1, 0.5, 0.1), color=vec(1/4,1/4,1) )
bird_wing2 = box(pos=vector(-0.5, 1, 0), size=vector(1, 0.5, 0.1), color=vec(1/4,1/4,1) )
bird_eye1 = sphere(color = color.black, radius = 0.1, pos = vec(-0.2,1,0.5))
bird_eye2 = sphere(color = color.black, radius = 0.1, pos = vec(0.2,1,0.5))
bird_beak = cone(pos = vec(0,0.8,0), radius = 0.3, length = 0.8, axis = vec(0,0,1), color = vec(1,1/2,0))
bird = compound([bird_head, bird_wing1, bird_wing2, bird_eye1, bird_eye2, bird_beak], pos = vec(0,0,0))


# 곰 객체 생성
bear_head = sphere( radius=2, pos=vec(-6,3,0), color=vec(3/4,2/3,2/5))
bear_ear1 = sphere ( radius=0.4, pos=vec(-5,5,-1), color=vec(3/4,2/3,2/5))
bear_ear2 = sphere ( radius=0.4, pos=vec(-7,5,1), color=vec(3/4,2/3,2/5))
bear_mouse = sphere ( radius=0.6, pos=vec(-5, 2.5, 1.5), opacity=0.8, color=vec(1,1,1) )
bear_cheek1 = sphere ( radius=0.6, pos=vec(-4, 2.5, 1), opacity=0.8, color=vec(1,0,0) )
bear_cheek2 = sphere ( radius=0.6, pos=vec(-6, 2.5, 2), opacity=0.8, color=vec(1,0,0) )
bear_eye1 = sphere( radius=0.4, pos=vec(-4.5, 3.5, 1), opacity=0.8, color=vec(0,0,0) )
bear_eye2 = sphere( radius=0.4, pos=vec(-5.5, 3.5, 2), opacity=0.8, color=vec(0,0,0) )
bear = compound([bear_head, bear_ear1, bear_ear2, bear_mouse, bear_cheek1, bear_cheek2, bear_eye1, bear_eye2], pos = vec(-6,0,0))

# 곰이 새에게 접근하는 애니메이션
for step in range(5):
    rate(10)  # 초당 프레임 수 조절
    bear.pos.x += 0.5  # 곰이 매 스텝마다 오른쪽으로 0.5 이동

bear_text1 = text(text=" hello ", pos=vector(-6,3,0), color=vec(3/4,2/3,2/5))
rate(0.5)  # 1초에 10 프레임
# 텍스트 객체 숨기기\
bear_text1.visible = False

bird_text = text(text=" oh! it's bear ", pos=vector(3,3,0), color=vec(1/4,1/4,1))
rate(0.5)  # 1초에 10 프레임
# 텍스트 객체 숨기기\
bird_text.visible = False

for step in range(10):
    rate(10)
    bird.pos.y += 1  # 곰이 새에게 접근하면 새가 위로 날아감
    bird.pos.x += 1
    
bear_text2 = text(text=" i'm sad ", pos=vector(-6,3,0), color=vec(3/4,2/3,2/5))
rate(0.5)  # 1초에 10 프레임
# 텍스트 객체 숨기기\
bear_text2.visible = False
